items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I'll never forget this old, I think it was Will Hudson, the ramming on some kind of serenade.

ctx.x: Well there's something I want to tell you too Bill. You remember when, I guess you heard about it, well that's before I went out on the road, when Paul Barberan had a cab in town. Well that was the time they had big bands, you know. Yeah. And he made up a big band. And I'll never forget this old, I think it was Will Hudson, the ramming on some kind of serenade. Oh, Moonlight or something? No, no, it wasn't.
No, no, I was just, they don't know it. Yeah.
